name: cable incline pushdown
description: A pulldown done reclined on an incline bench under a high pulley, bringing the bar from overhead to the upper chest. It targets the lats.
instructions: Set an incline bench in front of a high pulley with a straight bar, so the cable comes from behind your head.
Sit back against the bench and grip the bar overhead with straight arms, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar down in front of your face to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight overhead again.
